title: Amount column header is not sortable
detail: Header renders a sort affordance (↓) and is styled clickable, but clicking does not reorder rows. Same for Date.

title: Column-settings gear is inert
detail: The ⚙ in the header row has a hover state and pointer cursor but opens nothing.

title: Pagination does not paginate
detail: "Showing 1–25 of 31" offers a page 2; clicking it leaves the same 25 rows on screen.

title: Rows-per-page has no effect
detail: Selecting 50 still renders 25 rows — the renderer slices at a hardcoded 25.

title: Material icon ligatures leak into control text
detail: Controls read as e.g. ["tuneFilters","close","Platform arrow_drop_down"] to screen readers and text extraction — the ligature name is real text, not an image.

title: Colours not in the Synder token file
